description: Continuous edited terminal replay combining two scripted FDEOps runs. Real local code, tests, approved record writes and handover draft; fictional customers, no production deployment.

scenes.prompt: @fde Workshop done. Finance keeps reprocessing payments. Where do we start?
scenes.answer:
Trace one failed payment with finance: delivery, acknowledgement, write.
Check whether retries cause duplicates. Measure the recovery work first.

scenes.prompt: @fde Finance approved retry fixes. Keep the ledger unchanged.

Saved PAY-42: one payment write per customer and event, even after retries.
No ledger redesign. Check repeat delivery, restart and customer separation.
